fields.name: MapToPg*Attribute supported-type matrix
fields.description: The valid MapToPg*Attribute selections and compatible CLR model-property types. Each member's type names the PostgreSQL type selected by that variant (its NpgsqlDbType and the column definition it renders for bulk-load table creation, produced from one shared NpgsqlDbType-to-PostgreSQL type-name mapping); the description lists exactly the CLR shapes its IsValidType override accepts. Nullable forms are accepted only where listed; enum acceptance is limited to the string-family and integer variants. Any other shape is rejected with InvalidMapTypeException when the mapping is first built.

members.name: Varchar
members.description: MapToPgVarcharAttribute accepts string, enum, or nullable enum; length is required. A positive length renders varchar(n); a zero or negative length renders the unbounded varchar.

members.name: Char
members.description: MapToPgCharAttribute accepts string, enum, or nullable enum; length is required.

members.name: Text
members.description: MapToPgTextAttribute accepts string only (no enum or nullable-enum form).

members.name: Bigint
members.description: MapToPgBigintAttribute accepts long, enum, or nullable long; a nullable enum is NOT accepted.

members.name: Integer
members.description: MapToPgIntegerAttribute accepts int, enum, nullable int, or nullable enum.

members.name: Smallint
members.description: MapToPgSmallintAttribute accepts short, enum, nullable short, or nullable enum.

members.name: InternalChar
members.description: MapToPgInternalCharAttribute accepts byte, enum, nullable byte, or nullable enum. Its column definition renders the type as the double-quoted "char", which PostgreSQL requires to distinguish it from char(n).

members.name: Boolean
members.description: MapToPgBooleanAttribute accepts bool or nullable bool.

members.name: Numeric
members.description: MapToPgNumericAttribute accepts decimal or nullable decimal; precision and scale are required.

members.name: Money
members.description: MapToPgMoneyAttribute accepts decimal or nullable decimal.

members.name: Double
members.description: MapToPgDoubleAttribute accepts double or nullable double.

members.name: Real
members.description: MapToPgRealAttribute accepts float or nullable float.

members.name: Timestamp
members.description: MapToPgTimestampAttribute accepts DateTime or nullable DateTime. DateTimeOffset is NOT accepted: timestamp without time zone carries no offset, and DateTimeOffset properties map to TimestampTz.

members.name: TimestampTz
members.description: MapToPgTimestampTzAttribute accepts DateTimeOffset or nullable DateTimeOffset.

members.name: Date
members.description: MapToPgDateAttribute accepts DateTime or nullable DateTime (DateOnly is NOT accepted).

members.name: Time
members.description: MapToPgTimeAttribute accepts TimeSpan or nullable TimeSpan.

members.name: Interval
members.description: MapToPgIntervalAttribute accepts TimeSpan or nullable TimeSpan.

members.name: TimeTz
members.description: MapToPgTimeTzAttribute accepts DateTimeOffset or nullable DateTimeOffset only, and reads output parameters as DateTimeOffset. TimeSpan and nullable TimeSpan are NOT accepted: Npgsql maps PostgreSQL time with time zone only to DateTimeOffset, so TimeSpan time-of-day properties map to Time.

members.name: Array
members.description: MapToPgArrayAttribute accepts any CLR array type (Type.IsArray); its constructor requires the PostgreSQL element NpgsqlDbType, which is combined as NpgsqlDbType.Array | element. The column definition renders the element's PostgreSQL type name followed by [] (for example double precision[], "char"[], timestamp with time zone[], integer[]), never the raw enum name.

members.name: Bytea
members.description: MapToPgByteaAttribute accepts byte[] only; a length argument is required by the constructor but is not part of the rendered column definition.

members.name: Hstore
members.description: MapToPgHstoreAttribute accepts exactly IDictionary<string, string> (a concrete Dictionary<string, string> property type is NOT accepted).

members.name: Uuid
members.description: MapToPgUuidAttribute accepts Guid or nullable Guid.

representations.CSharp: Compatibility is enforced by each public MapToPg*Attribute variant's IsValidType(Type) override; constructors select the corresponding NpgsqlDbType; PgParameterMapAttribute.PgTypeName renders the PostgreSQL type name used in every column definition.
